satullapakāyika.p: [ (sati + u + laka + a=) satullapa + kāya=satullapakāya + ṇika ] (ti) CL=7 One who is being in the Deva realm due to the power of establishment of upright dhamma (wholesome dhamma).

satuppāda.p: [ sati + ñappāda ] (pu) CL=7 Arising of awareness (or)  awareness.

R:
satuppāda：သတုပ္ပါဒ （ပ） （သတိ+ဥပ္ပါဒ）
သတိဖြစ်ခြင်း။

sātudaka.p: [ sāta + udaka ] (ti) Google Translate with sweet water.

pn: Satulakāyī. The wife of Jotika. She came to him from Uttarakuru and brought with her a single pint pot of rice and three burning glasses (crystals). Whenever a meal was desired, the pot was placed on the crystals and the crystals blazed up. The food so prepared was never exhausted. When Jotika joined the Saṅgha, the divinities took Satulakāyī back to Uttarakuru. Dhp-a.iv.209, 223.
